camps.name: Audubon Summer Camp at the Nature Center and Aquarium
camps.description_short: Weekly themed nature camps at Audubon's Bristol refuge on Narragansett Bay: campers explore shore, salt marsh, fields and woods, meet live animals and visit the aquarium; older campers can join marine-biology and traveling-naturalist weeks.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Refund minus $60 for cancellations up to three weeks before the session; no refunds after that. Full refund if Audubon cancels.

sources.note: 2026 brochure, Bristol column. Drop-off camps for ages 5-12 (9am-3pm); Early Birds is a parent-and-child half-day program for ages 2.5-4. Non-member prices: half day $290, full day $400, Marine Biology $425, Traveling Naturalist $470 (members $50 less). Seekonk (Caratunk) site not included.

camps.name: Barrington Recreation Summer Camps: Cool Kids Camp & Camp Endeavor
camps.description_short: Town-run weekly themed day camp at Barrington Middle School, split into Cool Kids Camp for ages 5-7 and Camp Endeavor for ages 8-11, with crafts, projects, guest visits and a Thursday beach day for Camp Endeavor.

sources.note: Hours 9am-3pm. Week 1 is a short week ($175), no camp July 3. Camp Endeavor meets at Barrington Beach on Thursdays. Registration closes the Friday before each week at noon.
Camp page names Barrington Middle School as the location; street address and zip from the RI Dept. of Education school directory.

camps.name: Camp Crosby
camps.operator_name: Boys & Girls Club of East Providence
camps.description_short: Outdoor day camp on Mount Hope Bay in Bristol for kids entering K-8, with daily swims in the camp pool, field games and nature walks; campers ride a bus from the club's East Providence clubhouse.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Cancel in writing by 5pm the Tuesday before a session for a refund; otherwise refunds only for a doctor-documented medical absence covering the whole session.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Daily swim in the camp's outdoor pool.

sources.note: Ages derived from grades K-8. Buses leave the Williams Ave. clubhouse (115 Williams Ave, East Providence) at 8:30am. Before/after care ($50/$25 per week) extends hours to 6:30am-6pm. Club membership and $30 registration fee required. No camp July 3 and Aug 10.
Weekly rate is income/family-size tiered: $175, $205, $235; price_per_week is the top tier. Tiered sliding scale counted as financial aid (page also says RI DHS child care assistance accepted).
Parent handbook: lunch provided to all campers free of charge.

camps.name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Warwick STEAM Specialty Camp (Norwood Branch)
camps.description_short: Week-long STEAM sessions at the club's Norwood branch for kids entering grades 1-7, with hands-on science and engineering projects in the morning (with Warwick public school teachers) and traditional camp activities, pool and field trips in the afternoon.

sources.note: Page states the club's summer camp program is accredited by the American Camp Association.

Ages derived from grades 1-7. $245/week; $50 non-refundable deposit applied to fee. Hours 9-4; extended care 7-9am and 4-6pm for $24/week. Trips to McDermott Pool included. Club membership $30. Closed July 3 and Aug 10. CCAP accepted / limited financial aid.
Handbook: campers bring a bagged lunch.

camps.name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Warwick Traditional Summer Day Camp (Oakland Beach Branch)
camps.description_short: Eight-week traditional day camp at the club's Oakland Beach branch for kids entering grades 1-7, with weekly themes, STEM, sports, water play and crafts, plus weekly swim and field-game trips to the Masonic Youth Grounds in Buttonwoods.

sources.note: Page states the club's summer camp program is accredited by the American Camp Association.

Ages derived from grades 1-7. $235/week; $50/week non-refundable deposit applied to fee. Hours 8:30-4:30; extended care 7-8:30am and 4:30-6pm for $24/week. Optional field trips cost extra. Club membership $30. Closed July 3 and Aug 10. CCAP accepted / limited financial aid.
Handbook: campers bring a bagged lunch.

camps.name: Camp Ramsbottom
camps.description_short: Day camp on 170 acres in Rehoboth run by the Boys & Girls Club of Pawtucket, with two-week sessions of sports, crafts, nature, fishing, archery, drama and pool swimming; younger campers rotate by group, older campers can choose activities.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Refund (minus the $75 non-refundable deposit) only if the camp office is notified in writing 14 days before the session starts; balances due two weeks before the session.

sources.note: $600 per two-week session plus required club membership ($70/yr for non-Pawtucket residents). Lunch optional for $50/session. Extended care 7:30am-5:30pm, $100 per session. Buses from Pawtucket/RI and Norton, Seekonk and Attleboro stops. Brochure states ACA accredited. Phone is summer number.

camps.name: Camp Riverside
camps.operator_name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Metro South
camps.description_short: Boys & Girls Clubs of Metro South day camp at Lewis Park, a 100-acre site in Taunton's Myles Standish Industrial Park, for ages 5-15, with a half-day option for 5- and 6-year-olds.

sources.note: 2026: $275/week full day 8:45am-4pm; $215/week half day (ages 5-6). AM & PM extended care available.
2026 bus routes from Brockton, Bridgewater, Easton, Norton, Raynham and Taunton (no buses in Session I).

camps.name: Summer J-Camp
camps.operator_name: Jewish Alliance of Greater Rhode Island (Dwares JCC)
camps.description_short: Weekly themed day camp at the Dwares JCC on Providence's East Side for kids entering K-6, built around Judaism, arts, athletics and STEM, with daily swim lessons and weekly field trips.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Before April 1 weeks can be dropped for a full refund (registration fees and add-ons non-refundable); from April 1 on, cancellations are not refunded and week changes cost $50.

sources.note: Ages derived from grades K-6. Prices are non-member weekly rates (members $356; $286 for 4-day Week 2); registration fee $75 non-member. Early care 8:00-8:45 ($12.50/day), extended care 4:00-5:30 ($25/day). Lunch provided. Address is the Dwares JCC address in the page's structured data; camp arrival is at the Session St. playground. Week 2 has no camp July 3.

camps.name: East Greenwich Recreation Playground Camp at Cole Middle School
camps.description_short: Town-run half-day playground camp at Cole Middle School for kids entering grades 1-6 (full day on Fridays for field trips); can be paired with a morning specialty camp held at the same school.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Playground camps: cancel by June 1 for a refund; after that, refunds only if the spot can be filled from the waitlist.

sources.note: Ages derived from grades 1-6. Cole offers half-day only, 11:30-4:30 ($170 resident / $180 non-resident); half-day campers attend the full day on Fridays. No camp July 3. Scholarships (max $350/child/year) for families in the school free/reduced lunch program.
Brochure names Cole Middle School as the camp site; address from the town's facility page.

camps.name: East Greenwich Recreation Playground Camp at Eldredge
camps.description_short: Town-run playground day camp at Eldredge School for kids entering grades 1-6, with arts and crafts, sports, outdoor games, Wednesday visitors and Friday field trips; full- and half-day options.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Playground camps: cancel by June 1 for a refund; after that, refunds only if the spot can be filled from the waitlist.

sources.note: Ages derived from grades 1-6. Full day 9:00-4:30 ($225 resident / $235 non-resident), half day 11:30-4:30 ($170 / $180). No camp July 3. Scholarships (max $350/child/year) for families in the school free/reduced lunch program.
Brochure names Eldredge as the camp site; address from the school's website.

camps.name: French American School of Rhode Island Summer Camp

camps.description_short: Five weekly themed day camps at the French American School in Providence, run by bilingual staff, with cooking, crafts, science and sports in French and English; French is not required. Campers go to the pool in the afternoon.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Campers go to the pool in the afternoon; bring bathing suit and towel.

sources.note: Ages 3-10, 8:30-3:30. Full 5 weeks $1725. Campers bring lunch and snack; must be potty-trained.

camps.name: Summer at Gordon
camps.description_short: Weekly day camps on Gordon's 12-acre East Providence campus: a classic day camp for nursery to first grade plus 60-plus half- and full-day specialty camps (art, engineering, athletics and more) for older campers, with daily outdoor time and weekly water play.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Deposits are non-refundable. Camp fees refunded for cancellations before June 1; after that only if Gordon cancels a program. No proration for missed days.

sources.note: Open to campers entering nursery (age 3) through grade 8 in fall 2026; age_max 14 derived from grade 8. After care to 4:30 pm, $45/week. Campers pack their own lunch. Eight one-week sessions June 22-August 14, 2026; no camp July 6.
Classic day camp $230 half day / $415 full day (with discount); Quest for the Cup week $335. Specialty camps range about $230-$330 per half day.

camps.name: Blackhawk YMCA Day Camp
camps.description_short: YMCA day camp at Silver Lake Park in Bellingham, run with the town, for grades 1-6. Campers rotate through sports, crafts, water games, swimming and paddle boarding, with swim lessons in the camp day.

sources.note: Ages derived from grades 1-6. Non-member rates: $471/week, $358 for 3-day option. Weeks 2-10 offered (Weeks 1, 11, 12 not offered). Hours 8am-5:30pm.
FAQ: no pre or post camp for Blackhawk (full day already 8am-5:30pm); campers bring lunch; financial assistance linked.

camps.name: Camp Wapawca (Invensys Foxboro YMCA Day Camp)

camps.name: Norman Bird Sanctuary Summer Camps

camps.refund_policy_summary: Refunds through April 30, 2026 minus a 5% cancellation fee; no refunds after that unless the school cancels the camp.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Weather-permitting water play daily: sprinklers, water tables, water slides and waterfront swims.

sources.note: Full Day Camp ages 3-15. Weeks from the page's weekly-theme list (June 15-August 14); the camps-by-date list also shows an Aug 17-20 week, not included. camps.name: Summer ZooCamp

camps.refund_policy_summary: Full refund minus a $30 processing fee through June 1, 2026 for summer camp; no refunds after that unless a waitlisted child fills the spot.

sources.note: Summer programs: Tadpole Academy (4-5), Zoo Adventures (6-10), Conservation Heroes (11-14).

camps.refund_policy_summary: Full refund minus the $35 deposit until the program's registration deadline; after that, refunds only in limited cases such as waitlisting, unmet financial aid requests or illness/injury (prorated). No refunds for homesickness or weather. $15 fee per transfer.

sessions.name: Session 1: High Adventure Maine Outdoor Adventurers
Session 3: High Adventure New Hampshire Mountain Adventurers

sources.note: Programs listed for campers entering grades 1-12 (mini camps 1-5 and 6-12; full-week programs 2-12); ages derived from grades.

2026 Summer Camp Guide. Camps serve girls and gender-expansive youth. Campers not registered Girl Scouts must also pay a $55 GSUSA membership. CIT ($750) and Program Aide ($650) leadership sessions not listed. 2027 dates not yet published.

camps.name: YMCA Camp Fuller
camps.description_short: Traditional YMCA overnight camp on Point Judith Pond where campers pick their own weekly activities, from sailing, windsurfing and paddleboarding to archery, the climbing tower and mountain biking. Offers one-week starter sessions for ages 7-11 and two-week sessions for ages 7-15.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Non-refundable deposit due at registration: $300 for one-week sessions, $500 for two-week sessions.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Waterskiing and tubing on Point Judith Pond cost extra and require campers to be 10 or older.

sources.note: Site states Camp Fuller is a branch of the Greater Providence YMCA and is ACA accredited.
2027 pricing effective Nov 1; two-week early-bird price $2,310 before Nov 1. 2-week registration opened Sept 15, 1-week opens Nov 1.
Two-week sessions ages 7-15; one-week starter sessions (ages 7-11) dates and $1,360 price from https://www.campfuller.org/one-week-session.
Pickup/drop-off offered from Boston Logan, TF Green Airport and Kingston Train Station.
Street address taken from ACA profile; camp site does not list it.

camps.name: Attleboro Arts Museum Summer Art Weeks
camps.description_short: Week-long art sessions in the museum's studios for students who have finished K-3 or grades 4-8, pairing gallery visits with a different medium each morning and afternoon and ending with a Friday student art show.
camps.refund_policy_summary: No refunds, credits or transfers once payment is made, including missed or sick days.

sources.note: Museum's own 2026 flyer, hosted on a school district site. Groups by grade the student is leaving (K-3 or 4-8); ages derived from grades. Non-member: full day 9am-3pm $360, half day 9am-12:30pm $265; materials included. Scholarships available.

camps.name: Bulldog Youth Soccer Camp
camps.description_short: Four-day youth soccer camp on the Bryant University fields run by the women's soccer head coach, with skill sessions morning and afternoon and a midday lunch and pool break; half-day option for ages 5-6.

sources.note: Prices include $5 fees. Full day 9-3, half day 9-12. Campers bring lunch. $25 sibling/group discount.
University address; camp held on the fields at Bryant University.

camps.name: Capron Park Zoo Summer Outdoor Adventures
camps.description_short: Week-long zoo programs at Capron Park Zoo grouped by age, mixing daily zoo walks, animal ambassador encounters, crafts, games and science; 4-5 year olds attend a half-day morning or afternoon session.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Cancel before June 1 for a refund minus a $25 processing fee; no refunds after June 1.
camps.special_needs_notes: Reasonable accommodations for medical needs; families of children with emotional or learning challenges are asked to contact the education curator. Sessions capped at 15 participants.

sources.note: Non-member prices: $360 for ages 6-13 (9am-3pm), $200 for ages 4-5 half-day. Site says no before/after care and children bring lunch.

camps.name: Community Boating Center Summer Camps
camps.description_short: Nonprofit community sailing center at India Point Park running one-week EcoAdventure camps (sailing, kayaking, paddleboarding and environmental lessons) and two-week learn-to-sail camps, KidSail for ages 8-11 and TeenSail for ages 12-16.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Membership fees are non-refundable. Class cancellations made more than two weeks before class, if the spot is filled, are refunded minus a $30 fee; no reimbursement for missed classes.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming proficiency of 50 yards required (self-attested in online waiver).

sources.note: Campers bring a non-perishable lunch. Optional early drop-off (8:30) / late pick-up (4:00) buffer offered for traffic delays.
2026 registration package. A $25 CBC youth membership is required in addition to course fees. 'Sailorships' offer reduced tuition to qualified youth.

camps.name: Dean Summer Arts Institute
camps.description_short: One-week dance and musical theatre intensives at Dean College for high schoolers, with conservatory-style classes, college and audition prep workshops, and a supervised residential or commuter option.
camps.refund_policy_summary: 100% refund before July 6, 50% before July 13, none after July 13.

sources.note: Residential $1,800, commuter $1,500 per intensive; session price is residential. Staff-guided residential program with 24-hour supervision. Scholarships and payment plans available.

camps.name: East Bay Sailing Foundation Junior Sailing
camps.description_short: Nonprofit junior sailing program at Bristol Yacht Club with classes from Harbor Mice (ages 6-7, Fridays) through Mercury keelboat, Blue Dragon, Opti/O'pen Bic and 420 classes and race teams, running 9am-4pm weekdays in two-, four- or eight-week blocks.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Full refund minus a $30 fee if cancelled by June 1; $100 cancellation fee after June 1; non-refundable once the session begins.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Swim check at the start of each session: float 2 minutes in a life jacket and swim two lengths between the docks (four for race teams).

sources.note: 2026 sessions; prices are not published on the site. Bristol Yacht Club membership and Bristol residency not required (per site home).
Summer 2026 parent handbook; students bring their own lunch.

camps.name: Edgewood Sailing School Youth Sailing Program
camps.description_short: Nonprofit sailing school at Edgewood Yacht Club with weekly 9am-4pm classes: Starter Sailor (ages 7-13) mixes morning sailing on Rhodes 19 keelboats with afternoon STEM lessons, while Opti and 420 classes teach dinghy sailing and racing up to age 17.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Refunds are not available; tuition is due at registration.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Parents certify the child can swim 25 yards and/or tread water over a minute; life jackets worn at all times on docks and boats.

sources.note: 2026 classes. Starter Sailor students bring lunch from home. Additional fees: $25 annual registration and $24/week Edgewood Yacht Club youth student membership. Opti Intermediate and 420 classes run the same weekly dates at $430.

camps.name: Herreshoff Youth Summer Sailing Camp
camps.description_short: Weekly full-day sailing camp at the Herreshoff Marine Museum on Bristol Harbor, where campers learn to sail Herreshoff 12 1/2s, Sea Sprites, Bullseyes, Hobie Cats and O'pen Bics, with outings such as a Prudence Island day and a sail to Hog Island.

sources.note: Youth Program 2026 section. Monday-Friday 8:45-3:30. $425 first week, $400 second week, $375 third and later weeks; fee includes a museum family membership. Page also still contains outdated 2020 COVID notices; session price recorded as the one-week rate.

camps.name: Mansfield Arts YMCA Theatre Production Camp
camps.description_short: Two- and three-week sessions at the Mansfield Arts YMCA where campers in grades 2-9 rehearse and stage a full musical, with outdoor play in the afternoons and two public performances at the end.

sources.note: Pre & Post Camp add-on listed for weeks 4-9.

Ages derived from grades 2-9. Non-member prices: $1,077 for each 2-week show, $1,331 for the 3-week show (from theatre-production-camp-2 and -3 pages). Daily camp held at 40 Balcom Street; extra Saturday dress rehearsal.

camps.name: Resendes Soccer Academy Summer Camp at Bryant University
camps.description_short: Week-long soccer camp at Bryant University coached by staff from Bryant's Division I men's soccer program, with daily skill work and small-sided games for players from Pre-K through 8th grade; full- and half-day options.

sources.note: Pre-K through grade 8; age_max derived from grade 8. Full day 9:00-3:30 ($313.50 incl. fees), half day 9:00-12:30 ($261.25); Fridays half day for all. Camp 2 (Jul 27-31) from https://register.ryzer.com/camp.cfm?id=324105&sport=7.
University address; camp held at Bryant University.

camps.name: Sam Lopes Soccer Leadership Academy Youth Summer Camp
camps.description_short: Four-day soccer camp at Providence College taught by the college's women's soccer head coach and staff, covering technical and tactical skills, with afternoon pool time and games for full-day campers.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Full refund as credit toward a future camp if requested before June 1; no refund for dismissal or voluntary withdrawal.

sources.note: Prices include fees. Campers bring packed lunch. Page states the camp is not owned or operated by Providence College; it is held on the PC campus.
College address; camp held at Providence College.

camps.name: URI Youth Summer Sailing
camps.operator_name: University of Rhode Island Campus Recreation
camps.description_short: Monday-Thursday sailing camps at the URI Sailing Center on Point Judith Pond: half-day Tadpoles for ages 6-7, full-day beginner and intermediate learn-to-sail camps on Optis and RS Quests, and afternoon Water Sports Adventures with kayaks and paddleboards.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Cancellations by refund request form: $25 fee if at least two weeks before the start date, 30% fee if within two weeks.

sources.note: Community (non-URI) rates: Beginner/Intermediate full day $350, Tadpoles (ages 6-7, 9-12) $185, Water Sports (1-3pm) $160; URI faculty/staff rates lower. Intermediate is ages 12-17 (9-12 with coordinator approval).
